title: Odd Looking Rock
subtitle: A hidden stash near Westbrook Horse Ranch, Burning Springs

sections.title: Finding It
sections.html:
There's 1 Odd Looking Rock in Burning Springs. It's a fixed spawn, so it's always in the same place.

  • Check the map. Maps, at the bottom of the page, has the spot marked.
  • No note. Nothing in the game points to it: it's a hidden stash.

sections.title: How to Get There
sections.html:
Step 1 – Walk from Westbrook Horse Ranch

Fast travel to Westbrook Horse Ranch, run forward and jump onto the roof of the big red and white barn. Face south-east and keep going past the large tree on your left and the water pump on your right. Jump the fence and carry on to the white horse trailer. Climb onto the trailer and face east: a yellow sand path runs up the rock face ahead. Follow it to the top and on to the end, then turn right and look down. The Odd Looking Rock is right in front of you.
